target: acceptance 3 — a record with reproduce, localize and evidence but NO root-cause hypothesis is not a triage. This check had zero coverage: neutering it left all 11 cases passing.
cmd: e=$("$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/lib/triage.sh" validate "$FIXTURES/triage/no_hypothesis.md" 2>&1 >/dev/null); c=$?; n=$(printf "%s" "$e"|grep -ci hypothesis); printf '{"c":%s,"names":%s}' "$c" "$n"
